Name: Void's weird Wonders - Postbox building retexture
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
A little Alternative Textures mod that retextures the postbox building into a more oldschool type, so it fits for those who use a more toned down building retexture. It also comes with a version for the lovers of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/88875878]Idaida[/url]﻿'s [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186]Seasonal Gothic Buildings[/url][/i]! Go check her other lovely mods out while you're at it!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Alternative Textures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
As it only edits the postbox mod it's compatible with anything as it's just a AT retexture.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NSVKgHr/title2-1-see-also.png[/img]
